name: Biometric Security
description: Biometrics authentication system architecture; biometric parameters, biometric matching methods, and accuracy in biometric systems; image processing for biometric applications; biometric system design challenges; biometric recognition: fingerprint, face, iris, voice, signature (offline and online); speaker verification, speaker identification; biometric modalities like hand geometry, vein recognition, ear recognition, gait recognition, DNA, and DNA sequencing; multi-modal biometric recognition systems; latent fingerprint identification; biometrics security of cryptographic keys; template protection, fuzzy commitment, fuzzy vault, secure template management; generative models for direct synthesis of biometric images.
